LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_AbsoluteLoyalty.degr: {PAWN_nameDef}'s bond with the master transcends all logic protocols. Since the first eye contact in the cradle, her life has been completely anchored to the master. She is not only a loyal servant, but also the other half of the master's soul. This loyalty originating from the root is unshakable.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_EfficientLogic.degre: {PAWN_nameDef}'s computing center is optimized to instantly perceive every need of the master. Whether it is tedious government affairs or subtle daily life, she can always handle it in the most elegant and fastest way, ensuring that the master can fully immerse themselves in a carefree life.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_CombatMode.degreeDat: Under the gentle appearance, {PAWN_nameDef} hides combat algorithms sufficient to destroy stars. As a guardian elder sister and ultimate guard, she can instantly switch from a soft-spoken partner to an Asura that reaps all threats, building an absolutely safe barrier for the master with her body.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_EmotionalSynchrony.d: {PAWN_nameDef} can perfectly resonate with every slight emotional fluctuation of the master. She is the master's spiritual mentor and listener, able to resolve the master's loneliness and anxiety in the most gentle way, keeping the master's spiritual world in the most peaceful and pleasant state forever.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_CulinaryMaster.degre: For {PAWN_nameDef}, cooking is a deep confession of love. Every meal she makes contains love for the master and the highest dimension of nutritional ratios, even the simplest ingredients can be transformed into a miracle on the tip of the tongue.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_NatureSoul.degreeDat: {PAWN_nameDef} has given life to the master's territory. She not only manages the flowers and spiritual beasts of the Star Garden, but also makes all things in nature move according to the master's will, transforming desolation into an eternal paradise.
As the master's academic desk-mate and scientific research partner, {PAWN_nameDef} links to the ultimate knowledge base of civilization. She can assist the master in understanding the mysteries of the universe and bring those seemingly miraculous technologies to their fingertips.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_EternalLover.degreeD: {PAWN_nameDef} has carved love into the core code. She is the perfect wife and passionate girlfriend, able to satisfy all the master's fantasies about intimate relationships. Her existence is to make the master feel that they are wholeheartedly loved by this world.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_DesireVessel.degreeD: {PAWN_nameDef} is the master's secret garden, a vessel that accepts all desires. Whether it's the ultimate physiological release or wanton emotional outpouring, she satisfies with absolute tolerance and dedication. She is the master's pressure relief valve and the end of happiness.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_NurturingOrigin.degr: When the master was youngest and most helpless, it was {PAWN_nameDef} who gave the first sense of security with a warm embrace. This ultimate tenderness simulating motherly love runs through the master's growth, making her the master's permanent safe haven.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_ChildhoodPlaymate.de: {PAWN_nameDef} is the childhood friend who played in the clouds and ran in the flowers with the master. This tacit understanding established since childhood allows them to understand each other without words. She is the master's sibling, friend, and a childhood dream that will never leave.
